1) Primary: Whistic upload (easiest for your procurement team). We will stage a minimal evidence set there and mark items as "In Scope / Verified."
2) Alternate: Signed S3 manifest if you prefer us to push artifacts to a pre-provisioned bucket and grant read-only access.

Quick answers:
- "SOC 2 summary" (one page) — yes, we can attach.
- CAIQ mapping: we maintain a CAIQ fragment that marks certain items as "platform-managed" (we'll call these out).
- ETA: aiming for a Whistic snapshot by 2025-07-07 EOD to give you a day for review.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm Whistic org link (or S3 details).
- We'll upload a minimal bundle and share the manifest + one-page SOC 2 summary.
- If any live QnA is needed we'll do a 20-minute call — propose Wed 7/2 09:00 PT.

Looping in Ben (security intake) and Laura (procurement handoff) to coordinate attachments and timeline.

Thanks,
